about_the_game:
Welcome to BYTEWORLD, the game you've probably seen on TikTok!

BYTEWORLD is an unusual game, it is an online multiplayer sandbox game, where a giant VR controlled avatar goofs around with little robot players, however it comes with a twist:

There's only 1 lobby!

The lobby is opened 3 times a week at 6pm GMT for a few hours, and has limited slots, so it's a battle to get into!

But worry not, there is also singleplayer gameplay, that being the Level Editor and the Cosmetics Designer!

Design expansive worlds using the built-in level editor, and share the levels to the Steam workshop for everyone to see!

Or design your own custom outfits and make your Byte as fabulous as possible, the combinations are endless!

So consider this game a level editing, cosmetic designing application with an occasional added benefit of multiplayer interactivity!

All multiplayer lobbies are streamed live over at
